characters.name: A Boca de Vidro
characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Asset: six-scene production character sheet for Post Mortem Arena. Image1 exact IDENTITY reference for A Boca de Vidro, adult female humanoid spirit of Inferno, Elo Mentira. Preserve cool gray-blue skin, cyan eyes, long pale-blonde hair with braided crown over temples and loose face strands, slender gold earrings ending in long cyan crystal drops, dark teal/black high-collar coat and GOLD RING clasps at shoulders. Lower jaw and neck have elegant transparent refractive glass planes showing cyan inner light, but ONE normal closed or slightly open mouth, connected jaw and intact natural face. NOT gore, exposed anatomy, detached jaw, second mouth, vampire teeth or a monster made of broken bottle pieces. No eyewear. Same facial identity and clothing throughout.
STRICT hand-drawn 2D TV ANIME: clean bold ink, graphic hair clumps, flat cel colors, one hard shadow per surface, glass represented by clean angular cyan/white highlight SHAPES, no photorealistic skin/reflections, no 3D, no painted texture, no grain. Dark ominous intrigue, expressive anime eyes and attached normal limbs. Her power is speech becoming physical/piercing glass: not generic poison, not a sword-wielding knight.
Canvas exactly 1536x1024, 3 columns x 2 rows of SIX square illustrations, edge to edge, no gutters, borders, letters, words, captions or watermark. Top portrait/passive/skill1, bottom skill2/skill3/defense. All six scenes radically different cameras/settings within the old deceptive empire of Mentira. Keep meaningful action and identifiable caster in central safe area, readable at 75px.
1 TOP LEFT PORTRAIT: medium waist-up from low three-quarter angle at a DESERTED WIND OBSERVATORY above jade city rooftops, blue cloth vane blowing sideways. Woman turns toward distant dawn, braided pale hair catches wind; her transparent jaw and crystal-drop earring clearly distinguish her, no enemies, no extra faces in glass.
2 TOP MIDDLE Verdade Fraturada PASSIVE: close over ONE armored enemy's shoulder in a dim retired law office with scroll shelves and wax seals without writing. Foreground foe's shoulder armor has an ALREADY EXISTING open seam; woman at right studies the vulnerability quietly, cyan light from her glass jaw emphasizes that gap. No new attack, two figures total. No object in her eye, no mouth on armor.
3 TOP RIGHT Sílaba Cortante: dynamic SIDE PROFILE close-medium at a stone harbor stairway under rain, woman at left speaks with naturally slightly parted lips; ONE slim clean cyan GLASS CRESCENT forms just OUTSIDE her lips and flies toward ONE enemy's raised metal shield at right, passing through the shield's outer guard with white sparks, not through flesh. Two people, coherent connected hands; speech becomes piercing glass, no vomiting shards or huge open mouth.
4 BOTTOM LEFT Confissão Rachada: ground-level oblique action in a dry ruined public fountain COURTYARD. Woman's closed gloved fist drives ONE compact translucent glass impact into ONE enemy's raised armored forearm; guard plates split at a seam exposing an opening. ONE small resource jewel at enemy's BELT cracks and loses its glow, its fragments FALL DOWN to ground; nothing flies toward caster, because this removes a resource rather than steals it. No blood/gore, no bare flesh injury, just caster and one enemy.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE Discurso em Estilhaços: wide high diagonal view from behind woman's LEFT shoulder at an open abandoned STONE AMPHITHEATER. Caster foreground lower-left, EXACTLY THREE distinct armored enemies in shallow arc middle-right, each feet planted on same floor. Three clean angular glass sound crescents fan outward from her speech, one to each enemy's armor/guard; one already exposed armor seam shines brighter. Clearly attack all three foes, NOT protect allies. No fourth foe/crowd, no big empty generic blast, caster face partly in profile with crystal jaw.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT Reflexo da Boca PERSONAL DEFENSE: intimate frontal three-quarter in a narrow closed GLASSMAKER'S WORKSHOP, dark empty window frames, cobalt kiln bricks (no fire). Woman ALONE leans a shoulder sideways and her glass lower jaw emits one thin refraction plane across HER OWN torso. ONE incoming arrow bends past her shoulder and hits the wall behind; show ONE coherent real body/face, no solid clone, no shield dome or allies. No arrow through head, no duplicate earrings or extra arms.
Preserve exact hair, face, earrings, ring clasps and transparent jaw in each panel. Five fingers when visible, prefer closed hands, no props fused into hands, no captions. Scenes individually readable as passive / single piercing speech / guard-break drain / three-target speech / self-only evasion.

Man is humanoid, not a floating altar or an actual deity. Halo visibly chipped and assembled, not a perfect divine gold disc. Facial age/skin/physique/costume/hoop/halo consistent across six scenes.
Art style 100% 2D hand-drawn TV ANIME, clean black ink contours, simple expressive faces, cel shadows as flat graphic shapes, no realistic skin, pores, painterly brush texture, volumetric glow or 3D. Dark charismatic charlatan identity of Mentira, copper geometric false seals, deep teal shadow, burgundy and ivory costume; no generic green poison, thread net, speech-glass or random fire. Coherent two arms/two legs and five fingers; prefer closed hands. No gore, no writing/letters/text, watermark or decorative frames.
Canvas exactly 1536x1024, 3 equal columns x2 equal rows of SIX independent square cells, edge to edge NO gutters. Top portrait/passive/skill1, bottom skill2/skill3/defense. Readable silhouette and character at 75px; distinct camera/action/location per cell.
1 TOP LEFT PORTRAIT: waist-up low three-quarter under an abandoned elevated DEBATING PAVILION at storm dusk. He folds arms loosely, looking down with a composed cynical half-smile. Broken copper halo and navy ribbons frame bald head; huge slate clouds beyond torn teal banners. No followers, no crowd.
2 TOP MIDDLE Fé Desviada PASSIVE: intimate side close-medium seated alone at a cracked COUNTERFEIT RELIC WORKBENCH with blank copper plates and pliers. A faint narrow copper pulse descends from chipped halo to sternum, quietly restoring his own vitality at start of turn. One tiny existing mark of fatigue at forearm fades, no wound, no target drained, no attack or ritual victim. His real face and collar visible.
3 TOP RIGHT Promessa do Profeta: elevated reverse-three-quarter on an old indoor ADMISSION HALL staircase. Prophet LEFT makes one confident two-finger promise gesture with natural connected hand. ONE armored enemy RIGHT is hit on chest guard by a small angular COPPER SPIRITUAL SEAL; the seal remains as a small prophecy mark. ONE caster and ONE foe only. Halo stays behind prophet's head, no duplicate physical halos or faces, no blast affecting room.
4 BOTTOM LEFT Bênção Falsa SELF HEAL + REGEN + CHARGE: medium frontal kneeling in a dry lily CISTERN with broken water channels. Prophet ALONE presses one hand over his brass collar and closes the other around a chipped copper charm low at waist. Soft warm copper light mends his OWN fatigue, a slim recurring pulse follows ivory robe seam, and ONE small pale-gold charge point lights at collar. Not a shield, no other person blessed/healed. Single halo, face clear.
5 BOTTOM MIDDLE Milagre Fabricado: dynamic ground-level SIDE action in an abandoned open CLOCK COURT with a fallen dial and stone paving. Prophet drives ONE closed-fist PHYSICAL blow into ONE previously marked enemy's armored upper chest/raised guard. The small prophecy seal breaks brightly on enemy; up to THREE tiny charge points at prophet's collar go dark and their angular copper energy reinforces the physical impact. No third target, no follower, no body penetration/gore. The halo remains behind his head; the impact is a compact angular plate, not a detached hand.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT Imagem Sagrada PERSONAL DEFENSE: close low oblique under a silent old CHAPEL BELL ALCOVE (no religious insignia). Prophet ALONE opens his ivory robe into a compact faceted copper afterimage around his OWN torso. ONE incoming dart stops against the edge just outside him, chipped halo and bald face visible. It is only HIS personal invulnerability, no group sanctuary/dome, no duplicate solid body, no real wound. One connected coherent person.
Maintain reference costume, segmented halo, nose hoop and dark-brown skin even in shadow. All scenes different framing/settings. Avoid lookalike front-facing generic spellcasting poses and unnecessary background people.
